title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: provide opinionated RAG agent templates and concise tool-calling quickstarts to help engineers onboard agents faster and safely. This PR adds canonical templates for common RAG + agent patterns (email assistant, knowledge-base Q&A, and ticket triage), example tool wrappers (search, calendar, http-call), and step-by-step quickstarts in redwood-examples. It also updates the docs site to surface these quickstarts in the 'Agents & Tooling' section and adds example-run CI checks.

What changed: added templates under redwood-examples/agents/templates, new quickstarts under redwood-examples/quickstarts/agents, docs pages and sidebar updates in redwood-docs, example integration tests and CI job to run the quickstarts in a sandbox, and small SDK snippet improvements for tool-calling examples.

Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG agent templates (email-assistant, kb-qna, ticket-triage)
- [x] Add tool wrappers and examples (search, calendar, outbound-http)
- [x] Add quickstarts and runnable examples in redwood-examples
- [x] Docs pages and sidebar updates in redwood-docs
- [x] Add CI/examples-tests job and basic integration test harness
- [x] Address security review notes for tool timeouts and sandboxing

Notes: templates are intentionally small and opinionated (default retrieval = vector store, chunking policy, and safe tool whitelist). Quickstarts include environment variables and local sandbox instructions; they do not ship production credentials. This PR does not change runtime behavior - only examples and docs.
